verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an embeddable Drop-in Element that adapts its input fields to the payment method and country, with appearance and layout passed to createElement(...). Billing checkout components also include embedded checkout and elements as alternatives to the Hosted Payment Page, built on the @airwallex/components-sdk. missing for 10: evidence of native mobile/in-app SDK components, detail on individual card/field elements and the depth of customization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
